name: Fujiwara no Kiyosuke
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 84); Porter’s note gives the dates as: late 12th century.

poems.title: Time was when I despised my youth
poems.author: Fujiwara no Kiyosuke
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 84
poems.text:
Time was when I despised my youth,
As boyhood only can;
What would I give for boyhood now,
When finishing life’s span
An old decrepid man!

poems.title: 84. ながらへば また此の頃や しのばれむ (Nagaraeba mata konogoro ya shinobaremu)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Kiyosuke
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新古今集
poems.text:
ながらへば また此の頃や しのばれむ
憂しと見し世ぞ 今は戀しき
